result:
I've graded submission s1 for quiz 0001 and written `grades/0001-s1.json`, with feedback on every item.

You have the shape of the agent loop and why it needs a stopping rule, such as a step limit. You also know the model picks a tool from the tool's name and description, and that the result goes back to the model.

The idea to fix is who does what. The model only writes text, such as a tool request. The program runs the tool and calls the model again for each step, so a question that needs three tools takes four model calls. This matters for your budget, because every step is a separate paid call. You also added that the model remembers earlier sessions on its own, which it doesn't: anything it should know has to be written into its input each time.

Next step: redo q4 by drawing the four calls and what each one receives. Then tell me why the model needs a tool's result at all.

I also wrote a review record, a learning record on the two open misconceptions, and updated `NOTES.md`. The review hit its two-pass cap. I left some findings unchanged because they conflicted with the feedback skill's rule of opening with the general idea. The grader reported no key problems. Submission s2 is still ungraded.
